scripts.dev: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; elif [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 run.py; else exec python run.py; fi' || python3 run.py || python run.py
scripts.start: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; elif [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else exec python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi' || python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/pytest ]; then .venv/bin/pytest tests; elif command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest tests; else python3 -m pytest tests; fi'
